destination_denominator: checksum-valid successful returns; failed destinations separately retained

inference.bounds: Unclipped symmetric intervals; rates/fractions can have limits outside their physical range
inference.missing: If any run has no successful observations, that latency cell has n<5 and all estimates/CI blank
inference.unit: five run-level metrics; percentiles are averaged across runs, never pooled

sequential_treatment_audit.interpretation: Cross-host wall clocks check treatment overlap only. The nominal 1-second drain margin is not a precise physical clock bound; NTP offset/jitter evidence is retained. No latency or queue time is inferred from cross-host subtraction.

timing: Client monotonic latency and half-open completion windows within each origin; deadline inclusive. Worker clock spans are descriptive only; no cross-clock queue subtraction.
